title: Fire Escape Route Planning Tool
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js that implements an interactive fire escape route planning tool for a multi-floor building. The tool allows users to place fire sources, define escape routes, and simulate evacuation.

## Scene Setup
- Use an OrbitControls camera starting at position (30, 25, 30) looking at origin.
- Ambient light (0xffffff, 0.4) and a directional light (0xffffff, 0.8) at (20, 30, 10).
- Render a 3-floor building as a wireframe/transparent structure. Each floor is a 20x20 unit plane at y=0, y=5, y=10. Floors are semi-transparent (opacity 0.3) gray planes.
- Each floor has 4 rooms separated by thin wall segments (BoxGeometry). Rooms are labeled A, B, C, D per floor. Walls have small gaps representing doorways (width ~2 units).
- Place green cylinders (radius 0.3, height 3) at two building exits on the ground floor: one at (-10, 1.5, 0) labeled 'Exit North' and one at (0, 1.5, -10) labeled 'Exit South'.
- A stairwell column at position (8, 5, 8) connecting all floors, represented as a vertical yellow box (2x10x2).

## Floor Selection
- Add a DOM panel (top-left, id='floor-panel') with 3 buttons: 'Floor 1', 'Floor 2', 'Floor 3' (ids: 'btn-floor-1', 'btn-floor-2', 'btn-floor-3'). Clicking a floor button highlights that floor (opacity 0.6) and dims others (opacity 0.15). The active floor index is stored in state.

## Fire Placement Mode
- Add a toggle button (id='btn-fire-mode') labeled 'Place Fire'. When active, it gets a red background.
- In fire mode, clicking on the active floor's plane via raycasting places a fire source (orange-red sphere, radius 0.8, emissive 0xff4400) at the click point snapped to the active floor's y + 0.8.
- Each fire has a danger zone visualized as a red transparent ring/circle (radius 4 units) on the floor plane.
- Maximum 5 fires total across all floors. Attempting to place more shows a warning in a status div (id='status-text').
- Store fires as array of {x, y, z, floor} objects in state.

## Route Drawing Mode
- Add a toggle button (id='btn-route-mode') labeled 'Draw Route'. When active, it gets a blue background.
- In route mode, clicking on floor planes adds waypoints (small blue spheres, radius 0.3). Consecutive waypoints are connected by a blue line (THREE.Line with LineBasicMaterial, color 0x0066ff, linewidth 2).
- A route must start from any room and end at an exit marker or the stairwell. Store waypoints as array of {x, y, z} in state.
- Add a 'Clear Route' button (id='btn-clear-route') that removes all waypoints and lines.

## Route Validation
- Add a 'Validate Route' button (id='btn-validate'). When clicked, check:
  1. Route has at least 2 waypoints.
  2. The last waypoint is within 3 units of an exit or the stairwell.
  3. No waypoint is inside any fire's danger zone (distance < 4 from any fire center on same floor).
- Display validation result in a div (id='validation-result'): green text 'ROUTE SAFE' or red text 'ROUTE UNSAFE: [reason]'.
- Store validation state: { valid: bool, safeWaypoints: number, unsafeWaypoints: number, routeLength: number }.

## Evacuation Simulation
- Add a 'Simulate' button (id='btn-simulate'). When clicked (and route is valid), animate a small white sphere (the evacuee, radius 0.4) moving along the waypoints at speed 5 units/second.
- During simulation, track elapsed time and distance covered.
- When the evacuee reaches the last waypoint, display completion time in the status div and set simulation complete flag.

## Danger Heatmap Toggle
- Add a 'Toggle Heatmap' button (id='btn-heatmap'). When active, each fire's danger zone ring changes from transparent red to a gradient (inner red, outer yellow) by adding concentric rings. Store heatmap visibility boolean.

## State Management
- Expose window.__3D_STATE__ updated every frame with:
  - activeFloor: number (1, 2, or 3)
  - fireMode: boolean
  - routeMode: boolean
  - fires: array of {x, y, z, floor}
  - fireCount: number
  - waypoints: array of {x, y, z}
  - waypointCount: number
  - routeValid: boolean | null (null before validation)
  - safeWaypoints: number
  - unsafeWaypoints: number
  - routeTotalLength: number (sum of segment distances)
  - simulationRunning: boolean
  - simulationComplete: boolean
  - simulationTime: number (seconds, 2 decimal places)
  - simulationDistance: number
  - heatmapVisible: boolean
  - exitNorthPos: {x, y, z}
  - exitSouthPos: {x, y, z}
  - stairwellPos: {x, y, z}
  - cameraPosition: {x, y, z}

## Styling
- Dark background (#1a1a2e). All DOM panels have semi-transparent dark backgrounds with white text, rounded corners.
- Buttons have hover effects and clear active states.
physics_constraints: Fire danger zones are circular with radius 4 units centered on fire position, checked on the same floor only. Route length is the sum of Euclidean distances between consecutive waypoints. Evacuation speed is constant at 5 units/second. Simulation time = routeTotalLength / 5. Waypoints snap to the active floor's y-level. Maximum 5 fires enforced.
